example_response_snippet: curl: (6) Could not resolve host: dns0.eu
resolution_notes: base_url: replace; official DoH documentation identifies https://dns0.eu/ as the resolver endpoint, not api.dns0.eu (https://docs.dns0.eu/known-issues/dns-over-https-windows-11). docs_url: replace with the official documentation root (https://docs.dns0.eu/). example: replace; the resolver no longer resolves, so no working API example exists. DNS0.eu announced that the service was discontinued (https://www.dns0.eu/), consistent with both supplied HTTP 0 checks; status is defunct.
